clips.title: The story
paras: Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf sentinel stationed southwest of Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains. From her small outpost, she coordinates with fellow sentinels to monitor escalating tensions and regional disruptions in the wilderness. She relies on brave travelers to scout dangerous territory and learn what has corrupted the land's ancient defenders.

Positioned just southwest of the industrial devastation of Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear keeps a watchful vigil over the surrounding passes. The Stonetalon Mountains are fraught with danger as the Horde encroaches and goblin operations exploit the land's natural bounty. Operating alongside the gnome Gaxim Rustfizzle, Kaela acts as an essential forward liaison for the night elves, tracking threats that push deeper into ancestral territory.

The unrest in Stonetalon goes far beyond territorial skirmishes. The violent disruption of nature has agitated the elementals and brought harm to ancient guardians of the forest. Kaela works tirelessly to dispatch adventurers against raging elemental spirits and to learn what has corrupted the wounded ancients, the treants who once guarded the Vale, striving to restore peace before the land is irrevocably scarred.
